This leads to relative URLs not resolving as expected in the browser. **Example Code:** ```python from scrapy.http import HtmlResponse def open_in_browser(response, _openfunc=None): body = response.body if isinstance(response, HtmlResponse): if b' into the tag body = body.replace(b'', b'') # Additional logic to open the browser # HTML response with comments and attributes in the tag response = HtmlResponse( 'http://www.example.com', body=b""" Dummy

Hello world.

""" ) open_in_browser(response) ``` **Expected Behavior:** The `` tag should be successfully injected within the `` section of the HTML, regardless of comments or additional attributes. This ensures that all relative URLs in the page resolve correctly based on the specified base URL. **Actual Behavior:** The `` tag is not injected when the `` tag contains comments or additional attributes. As a result, relative URLs do not resolve based on the intended base URL, which can lead to broken links or incorrect resource loading in the browser. [/ISSUE]
